description: 5 table + 5 text MSFT FY2025 questions for dual-path inference smoke test.

questions.question: According to Microsoft's MD&A summary results table, what was gross margin in fiscal year 2025?
What was Microsoft's total operating income in fiscal year 2025 per the MD&A summary table?
What were Microsoft's general and administrative expenses in fiscal year 2025?
What was Productivity and Business Processes operating income in fiscal year 2025?
What was Microsoft's interest expense in fiscal year 2025 according to the other income (expense) table?
What three reportable segments does Microsoft use to report financial performance?
questions.gold_answer: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing

questions.question: What sustainability goals did Microsoft announce in 2020 for 2030?
questions.gold_answer: Carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste

questions.question: What competitive advantage does Microsoft cite for Azure related to hybrid cloud?
questions.gold_answer: Enabling a hybrid cloud that allows deployment of existing datacenters with the public cloud into a single cohesive infrastructure, at scale for businesses of all sizes

questions.question: What are the primary components of Microsoft's More Personal Computing segment?
questions.gold_answer: Windows and Devices, Gaming, and search and news advertising

questions.question: How does Microsoft describe competition in AI technology and services in its risk factors?
questions.gold_answer: AI is a highly competitive and rapidly evolving market with new competitors continuing to enter the market
